Resource Profile: Media - FR Media Document

Official URL: https://interop.esante.gouv.fr/ig/fhir/document-core/StructureDefinition/fr-media-document Version: 0.1.0-ballot
Draft as of 2026-11-17 Computable Name: FRMediaDocument

FRMediaDocument permet de positionner une image de type gif, jpeg, png ou bm. Elle est encodée en base 64

Usages:

  • Refer to this Profile: DiagnosticReport - FR Diagnostic Report Document and Observation - FR Observation Laboratory Report Results Document

You can also check for usages in the FHIR IG Statistics
